resume: A sad wavetable synth and drum machine: no menus or numbers, a blob that is the sound and changes as you turn the knobs. 8 wavetables, 6 voices, 21 presets and 13 drum styles.

commandes.role: Octave down; in SEQ, goes to another bar.
Octave up; in SEQ, goes to another bar.
Tears page: chorus, delay, time, feedback.
Walls page: reverb, size, fry, tape.
Mouth page: attack, decay, sustain, release.
Vibe page: speed, depth, shape, destination.
Eyes page: cutoff, resonance, envelope amount, modulation decay.
Mixer page (voice, drums, bass, gunk); a second time, Setup.
Returns to the Body page (table, position, detune, sub).
Saves; held 1.5 s then SAVE again: reset.
One press: arpeggiator on or off. Held: its page.
Piano roll loop; a second time, the Tape deck. The 16 white keys are then the steps of one bar.
Starts or stops the group: drums, bass and loop.
When stopped: a one-bar count-in then recording. During playback: immediate overdub; REC again stops it.
Loads a complete sound from eight; its card opens in the drawer.

gestes: HOME + REC: undoes the last take.
Press a page button twice quickly: its drawer stays open until HOME.

modes.texte: Pressing a part's button opens its diagram in a drawer, and KNOB 1 to 4 set that part. The drawer retracts 3 seconds after the last gesture, but the page stays active.

a_savoir: MOPE-1 stores its sound and loop in the same flash slot as FiMba-1 and FoMni: it does not read their projects and overwrites them when saving.
